P.name: Damnation
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} Enemy {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|minions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} that die near '''Thresh''' drop a ''Soul'' for 8 seconds. Epic monsters drop 2 ''Souls'' while lesser minions and monsters have a {{fd|33.{{recurring|3}}}}% chance to drop a ''Soul''.
P.description3: '''Thresh''' automatically collects ''Souls'' near him or a placed ''{{ai|Dark Passage|Thresh}}''.
P.description4: {{sbc|Soul:}} For each {{tip|stack}}, '''Thresh''' gains {{sti|ap|{{as|1 ability power}}}} and {{sti|armor|{{as|1 '''bonus''' armor}}}}.

Q.name: Death Sentence
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Thresh''' throws out his scythe in the target direction, becoming {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack while it is in flight.
Q.description2: The scythe catches the first enemy hit to deal {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|stun}} and {{tip|true sight|reveal}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, and render them {{tip|airborne}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.4}} seconds|Estimated}}, as well as reduce ''Death Sentence's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by 2 seconds. '''Thresh''' will also mark the target ''Shackled'' for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which he is unable to declare basic attacks, and is {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20% for 1 second.
Q.description3: While the target is {{tip|stun|stunned}}, '''Thresh''' tugs his hook towards him twice, once after a {{tt|{{fd|0.1}}-second delay|Estimated}} and again {{tt|{{fd|0.6}} seconds|Estimated, starting from the end of the initial delay}} after that. With each tug, the target is pulled a short distance towards '''Thresh'''. After {{fd|0.5}} seconds of hitting an enemy, or instantly after hitting a {{tip|minion}} or {{tip|monster}}, '''Thresh''' can recast the ability while the target is ''Shackled''.
Q.description4: {{sbc|Recast - Deathly Leap:}} '''Thresh''' stops tugging his hook and {{tip|dashes}} to the ''Shackled'' enemy, becoming able to attack again upon arrival. He can cast ''{{ai|Dark Passage|Thresh}}'' and ''{{ai|Flay|Thresh}}'' during the dash.

Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Thresh''' throws out his scythe in the target direction, becoming {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack while it is in flight.
Q.description2: The scythe catches the first enemy hit to deal {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|stun}} and {{tip|true sight|reveal}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, and render them {{tip|airborne}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.4}} seconds|Estimated}}, as well as reduce ''Death Sentence's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by 2 seconds. '''Thresh''' will also mark the target ''Shackled'' for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which he is unable to declare basic attacks, and is {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20% for 1 second.
Q.description3: While the target is {{tip|stun|stunned}}, '''Thresh''' tugs his hook towards him twice, once after a {{tt|{{fd|0.1}}-second delay|Estimated}} and again {{tt|{{fd|0.6}} seconds|Estimated, starting from the end of the initial delay}} after that. With each tug, the target is pulled a short distance towards '''Thresh'''. After {{fd|0.5}} seconds of hitting an enemy, or instantly after hitting a {{tip|minion}} or {{tip|monster}}, '''Thresh''' can recast the ability while the target is ''Shackled''.
Q.description4: {{sbc|Recast - Deathly Leap:}} '''Thresh''' stops tugging his hook and {{tip|dashes}} to the ''Shackled'' enemy, becoming able to attack again upon arrival. He can cast ''{{ai|Dark Passage|Thresh}}'' and ''{{ai|Flay|Thresh}}'' during the dash.

W.name: Dark Passage
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Thresh''' throws his lantern to the target location over {{fd|0.5}} seconds, lasting for 6 seconds while he remains nearby and granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. If '''Thresh''' moves too far away from the lantern, it returns back to him immediately.
W.description2: '''Thresh''' and the first allied champion to come near the lantern are granted a {{tip|shield}} for 4 seconds. An ally can select the lantern while in proximity of it, {{tip|dash|dashing}} to '''Thresh''' and gaining the shield.
W.description3: ''An ally cannot select the lantern while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}}. The lantern will not expire from '''Thresh''' moving too far away if he is dashing with {{ai|Deathly Leap|Thresh}}.''

E.name: Flay
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Thresh's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, with the {{sti|{{as|AD}}}} ratio increasing over 10 seconds without basic attacking enemies.
E.leveling:
{{st|Minimum Bonus Magic Damage|{{fd|1.7}} per {{ai|Damnation|Thresh|Soul}} collected {{as|(+ 0% AD)}}}}
{{st|Maximum Bonus Magic Damage|{{fd|1.7}} per {{ai|Damnation|Thresh|Soul}} collected {{as|(+ {{ap|90 to 210}}% AD)}}}}
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Thresh''' sweeps his chain across the ground in a broad line and a radius around him, starting behind him and towards the target direction. Enemies hit are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocked}} 200 units in the target direction, and then are {{tip|slow|slowed}} for 1 second.

R.name: The Box
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Thresh''' erects a pentagon of spectral walls around him that each last for 5 seconds. A wall will break upon enemy champion contact, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 99% for 2 seconds. After the first wall breaks, the rest will deal no damage and {{tip|slow}} for only 1 second.
R.description2: Enemies that break a wall cannot do so again for 1 second.
